title: Lesson 13 - Golden record / system of truth in a single org: identity resolution, dedup, match rules
description: Given a customer scenario, recommend and use techniques for establishing a golden record or system of truth for the customer domain in a single Salesforce org, including identity resolution, deduplication, and matching rules.

questions.question: A single org receives customer records from a portal (with a stable portal ID) and from manual entry (no ID). What is the best identity-resolution approach?
options: Deterministic matching on the portal external ID for portal records, fuzzy matching for manual records
Merge every record with a similar name
questions.explanation: Use deterministic external-ID matching where a stable key exists and fuzzy matching only where it does not; fuzzy-for-all (A) is weaker, and blocking entry or name-only merging is wrong (C, D).

questions.question: Which TWO statements about Duplicate Rules are TRUE?
options: They can Block a save at the UI and/or via API
They can only warn the user, never prevent a save
They combine a matching rule with an action (Alert/Block/Allow)
They permanently merge duplicate records automatically
questions.explanation: Duplicate Rules combine matching with actions and can Alert or Block, including via API (A, C); they never auto-merge (D) and are not warn-only (B).

questions.question: A golden record is established for Account, but the telephony system is authoritative for phone numbers. What does this imply?
options: Account is not really the golden record
System of truth is attribute-level: Account masters the record, telephony masters phone
Phone must be removed from Salesforce
A second Account golden record is needed
questions.explanation: Golden records are often composite with per-attribute authoritative sources; the record can still be mastered in Salesforce while one attribute is sourced elsewhere.
